Subject: ZenHealth - technical deep dive (proposed 60-90 min) & next steps

Hi Priya / Tom,

Thanks again for the call today - appreciated the level of detail on your product workflow and latency expectations. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we can get the ML/infra folks aligned:

Recap (short):
- Primary use case: realtime clinical triage assistant (prompted generation + entity extraction) for care coordinators.
- Expected peak: ~35-50 RPS during business hours, spiky bursts; 99th pct latency target ~250-350ms.
- Data: PHI may be present in prompts; customer needs VPC/private deployment and KMS integration.
- Evaluation metric: generation quality + hallucination rate on a ~2k prompt test set.

Proposed next step:
We recommend a 60-90 minute technical deep dive with your ML + infra leads to walk through:
1) model selection and quantization tradeoffs (latency vs quality)
2) serving topology: private vs dedicated vs hosted + data residency
3) autoscaling, KV/prefix caching, and expected cost profile at your scale
4) security/compliance & SOC2 evidence you asked about
5) success criteria and next milestones (POC plan + timeline)

Proposed slots (PT):
- Wed Aug 5: 10:00-11:30 PT (90 min)
- Thu Aug 6: 14:00-15:30 PT (90 min)
- If you prefer a shorter 60-min slot we can do Thu Aug 6: 14:00-15:00 PT.

Please let me know which slot works and who from your side should attend (ML lead, infra/ops, engineering manager). I've attached a one-page proposed agenda and our SOC2 questionnaire (partial) for the team to review before the meeting.

If those times don't work, share a couple of alternatives and we'll adjust. Once we lock a time I'll send a calendar invite and a short prework checklist so the deep dive is productive.

Thanks,

--
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123
